content: Standard Spring Boot + Kotlin + Postgres + Flyway setup: add spring-boot-starter-data-jpa, org.postgresql:postgresql (runtime), org.flywaydb:flyway-core + flyway-database-postgresql; set spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto=validate (never 'update'/'create' in real use) and let Flyway own schema via versioned SQL files in src/main/resources/db/migration named V<version>__description.sql. Testcontainers-postgresql is the standard approach for integration-testing the persistence layer against a real Postgres instance rather than H2.
